verses.text: These are the rules and laws you must be careful to obey in the land the LORD, the God of your ancestors, has given you to own, for as long as you live on the earth.
Completely destroy all the places where the nations you are driving out worshipped their gods, on the high mountains, on the hills, and under every green tree.
Tear down their altars, smash their holy stone pillars, and burn their Asherah poles in the fire. Cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.
Do not worship the LORD your God in the way they worship their gods.
Instead, go to the place the LORD your God will choose from among all your tribes as the place where his name will live. Look for that place where he lives, and go there.
Bring there your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tenth parts and special gifts, what you have promised, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your families will eat and be glad about everything you have worked for, because the LORD your God has blessed you.
You must not do as we are doing here today, where everyone does whatever they think is right.
For you have not yet arrived at the place of rest, the land the LORD your God is giving you as your own.
But you will cross the Jordan and live in the land the LORD your God is giving you as your own. He will give you rest from all the enemies around you, and you will live in safety.

Then bring everything I command you to the place the LORD your God will choose as the place where his name will live: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tenth parts and special gifts, and all the best things you have promised to the LORD.
And be glad there in the presence of the LORD your God, you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites living in your towns, who have no share of land of their own.
Be careful not to offer your burnt offerings anywhere you like.
Offer them only at the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribes. There you must do everything I command you.

But you may kill and eat meat in any of your towns, as much as you want, according to the blessing the LORD your God gives you. Both people who are unclean and people who are clean may eat it, as they would eat gazelle or deer.
But you must not eat the blood. Pour it out on the ground like water.

Do not eat these things in your own towns: the tenth part of your grain, new wine, or olive oil, the firstborn of your herds or flocks, anything you have promised to give, your free will offerings, or your special gifts.

Instead, eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose, together with your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites living in your towns. Be glad in the presence of the LORD your God about everything you have worked for.
Be careful never to forget the Levites as long as you live in your land.
When the LORD your God makes your land larger, as he promised you, and you want to eat meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much meat as you want.

If the place the LORD your God chooses for his name is too far away from you, you may kill animals from the herds and flocks the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you. You may eat as much of it as you want in your own towns.
Eat it as you would eat gazelle or deer. Both people who are unclean and people who are clean may eat it.
But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life. You must not eat the life with the meat.
Do not eat the blood. Pour it out on the ground like water.
Do not eat it, so that all will go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the LORD's eyes.
But take your holy gifts and what you have promised to give, and go to the place the LORD will choose.

Offer your burnt offerings, both the meat and the blood, on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.

Be careful to obey all these words I am giving you, so that it will always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
The LORD your God will wipe out the nations ahead of you in the land you are going in to take. When you have driven them out and are living in their land,

be careful not to be trapped into following their ways after they have been destroyed ahead of you. Do not ask about their gods and say, "How do these nations worship their gods? We will do the same."

You must not worship the LORD your God in their way, because they do for their gods every hateful thing the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.
Be careful to do everything I command you. Do not add anything to it or take anything away from it.
